ORDER

This application, by Mst. Nuzhat
Rehman, seeks transfer of a suit for restitution of conjugal rights from the
Court of Judge Family Court, Depalpur, District Okara to the Court of learned
Senior Civil Judge/Judge Family Court, Bahawalnagar where her suit for
dissolution of marriage is pending adjudication.

2. Facts are: that Mst. Nuzhat
Rehman/applicant herein was married with Inamâ€‘ulâ€‘Haq/respondent on
1â€‘11â€‘1995. From this wedlock a child namely Usama was born in year
1997. In 1999, relations between the two became strained. Feeling aggrieved,
applicant tiled a suit for dissolution of marriage in the Court of Senior Civil
Judge/Judge Family Court, Bahawalnagar on 17â€‘12â€‘1999. The
respondent also did not lag behind. He too tiled a suit for restitution of
conjugal rights in the Court of Mian Muhammad Abdur Rafique, Judge Family
Court, Depalpur, District Okara on 13â€‘12â€‘1999. This is how this
application has come to this Court.

3. It is contended that applicant
is a Pardahâ€‘observing lady; that she is residing. in Bahawalnagar
District and that she cannot defend her cause at Depalpur, District Okara.
Respondent, despite service, has not entered appearance. He is, therefore,
proceeded against ex part.

4. Manifestly, applicant is a
Pardah observing lady; that she is residing in Bahawalnagar District and that
she cannot prosecute her cause at Depalpur, District Okara. None has entered
appearance to controvert this position. Taking the aforesaid circumstances into
consideration, I am inclined to allow this application with the result that
suit for restitution of conjugal rights is withdrawn from the Court of Mian M.
Abdul Rafique, Judge Family Court, Depalpur and entrusted to Senior Civil
Judge/Judge Family Court, Bahawalnagar. The first Court shall send immediately
the record of restitution suit to the transferee Court and the learned
transferee Court shall decide the matter as quickly as possible after affording
opportunity of hearing to both sides.
